purpose: Fictitious, editable demonstration data for a newly generated sample ACCDB, requested by the user. This is separate from formal test fixture initialization.
invocation: Build-Access.ps1 calls the entry point when IncludeTests is false; never called by normal Form_Load. Insertions require StudentSampleBootstrapAllowed=True and either the generated .tmp/generation/frontend.accdb staging location or an explicit StudentTestFixture=True database. The published database always has StudentSampleBootstrapAllowed=False.
baseline: BusinessDay(UtcNow()), JST; April-based school year. The first seed basis day is pinned in database properties for idempotent reapplication.
dataSafety: Names and addresses explicitly describe fictitious samples.
Email uses the reserved .invalid domain; telephone examples contain only zeros.
Existing reserved keys without the sample marker are rejected before any insert.
Existing sample rows, user-created rows, row versions, and audits are never overwritten or deleted by reapplication.
All class/student writes use production maintenance/student services, validation, FK checks, occupancy checks, optimistic versions, and transactional audits.

Bootstrap creates are restricted to disposable build staging or explicitly enabled test fixtures. A failed build is never published; the existing final ACCDB remains unchanged. The individual business-service transactions are not one outer transaction.
A published database with missing sample keys fails before any insertion. Existing edited or logically deleted sample rows are retained and skipped.
coverage: literal student-number prefix and name search
ten- and eleven-digit domestic telephone normalization
complete emergency-contact group and true NULL optional fields
Showa final day / Heisei first day / Reiwa first day / leap day
current, full, empty and historical classes
